title: Power Platform DLP & Connector Governance in Copilot Studio
summary: Enforce Business vs. Non-Business vs. Blocked DLP policies and prevent cross-group connector quarantine in Copilot Studio.

intro.what: Copilot Studio agents execute inside Power Platform environments governed by Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies.
intro.features: Combining a Business connector (SharePoint, Excel Online) with a Non-Business connector (external HTTP/SaaS) in one agent triggers immediate DLP suspension.
intro.exchange: Restrict Office 365 Outlook send actions behind explicit confirmation cards and approved service accounts where required.
intro.m365: Configure dedicated Copilot Studio environment DLP rules covering knowledge sources, triggers, and connectors.
intro.developer: Use Environment Variables and Connection References so solutions promote cleanly across Dev, UAT, and Prod.
sources: Microsoft · Configure DLP policies for Copilot Studio agents

sections.title: DLP Classification & Connector Hygiene
paragraphs: Every connector in Copilot Studio belongs to Business, Non-Business, or Blocked. Engineers should classify SharePoint, OneDrive, Excel Online (Business), Microsoft Teams, and Planner in Business, isolate external APIs in Non-Business, and block unauthenticated HTTP or consumer connectors.
Always enable user confirmation on write-back actions (POST/PUT/DELETE) to mitigate prompt-injection data corruption.

rows: Quarantined if mixed with Business connectors

sources: Microsoft · Configure DLP policies for Copilot Studio agents

title: Deterministic Topics, Adaptive Cards & Action Confirmation
summary: Architect structured Copilot Studio topics with entity extraction, input validation, Adaptive Cards, and mandatory write confirmation.

intro.what: How to replace fragile free-text prompt parsing with deterministic Topic graphs and strongly typed variables.
intro.features: Uses Question nodes with entity validation (Date, Number, Closed List), Power Fx formulas, and confirmation prompts.
intro.exchange: Format structured approval summaries before dispatching notifications.
intro.m365: Bind Excel Online and SharePoint List actions via Connection References.
intro.developer: Enforce idempotency keys or duplicate checks before inserting rows.
sources: Microsoft · Add actions and connectors in Copilot Studio

sections.title: Engineering Pattern: Validate -> Preview -> Confirm -> Mutate
paragraphs: 1. Entity Extraction & Validation: Use Closed List entities for finite options (e.g., Facility/Lot) and numeric bounds checks.
2. Power Fx Business Logic: Evaluate threshold rules deterministically in Condition nodes rather than relying solely on LLM arithmetic.
3. Human-in-the-Loop Confirmation: Render all resolved parameters in an Adaptive Card or Yes/No prompt prior to invoking the connector.
4. Idempotent Write & Receipt: Append row with a deterministic RequestID and return confirmation metadata.
sources: Microsoft · Add actions and connectors in Copilot Studio

title: ALM Solutions, Event Triggers & Multi-Agent Orchestration
summary: Package Copilot Studio agents inside Power Platform Solutions, configure filtered event triggers, and orchestrate modular sub-agents.

intro.what: Production engineering lifecycle for autonomous and multi-agent architectures in Copilot Studio.
intro.features: Uses Unmanaged -> Managed Solution promotion, Environment Variables for SharePoint/Excel IDs, and modular sub-agent delegation.
intro.exchange: Filter event triggers tightly so background runs only fire on actionable thresholds.
intro.m365: Publish approved agents to the Microsoft 365 Admin Center Integrated Apps catalog.
intro.developer: Inspect Copilot Studio Activity transcripts and Purview audit logs for every autonomous trigger invocation.
sources: Microsoft · Export and import agents using solutions
Microsoft · Orchestrate multiple agents in Copilot Studio

sections.title: ALM & Multi-Agent Modularity
paragraphs: Never author production connector agents directly in the Default environment. Build inside a dedicated Developer Sandbox, parameterize SharePoint site URLs and workbook IDs using Environment Variables, export as a Managed Solution, and promote through UAT to Production.
For complex domains, decompose logic into focused specialist child agents (each with <=5 knowledge URLs) orchestrated by a parent router agent with crisp tool descriptions.
sources: Microsoft · Export and import agents using solutions
